appDesc.message: A calm, simple start page built around your bookmarks, in their real order. As it always should have been.

glowHint.message: It follows the sun, from the left in the morning to the right in the evening. Sky takes the colors of the day, inspired by Japanese colors: pink at dawn, sky blue through the day (a pale aqua in winter), peach then pink at sunset, wisteria at night. It follows the season too: longer days in summer, paler and cooler in winter. The other colors keep their hue and soften at night. Pastels drifts slowly from one soft color to the next.

columnsHint.message: Drag to reorder, here or by a column's header. Folders move in your bookmarks bar too.

dataHint.message: Saves ReStart's own settings: folder colors and icons, hidden columns, pinned sites, the place of the extra columns, and appearance. Your bookmarks and their order belong to your browser, which saves them with its sync or its bookmark export. Folders are matched by name.

importMissing.message: Not found in your bookmarks, so not restored: $NAME$. Folders are matched by name.

importNew.message: Not in the backup: $NAME$. They keep their default look.

layoutNarrowHint.message: Applies to wide windows. Narrow windows always show a list.

invalidUrl.message: Enter a valid web address, such as https://example.com.

awakeHow.message: Stops the screen from turning off and the computer from going to sleep, but only while ReStart is shown: it pauses when you switch to another tab or hide the window, and starts again when you come back.

awakeAlways.message: On until you turn it off

hideColumn.message: Hide this folder (show it again in Settings, Columns)

deleteFolderWarn.message: The folder and everything in it will be deleted from your browser's bookmarks.

emptyHint.message: This folder has no bookmarks yet: it shows up once it has one.

focusHint.message: Hides your bookmarks and keeps only the background, for a calm tab or a shared screen. Turn it on and off with the Focus button: it stays on in every new tab until you turn it off.

leavesHint.message: Soft shadows of leaves on a sunlit wall, swaying slowly in the wind.

startHintTop.message: Make this page yours: right-click a site to add it to your bookmarks.

startHintEmpty.message: Add sites to your bookmarks bar in your browser: they appear here, in the same order.

w1Title.message: A fresh start, every new tab.

w1No.message: No feeds. No ads. No tracking.

w1Just.message: Just your bookmarks, laid out in a calm, clean space that gets you where you are going.

w2Title.message: A page that follows your day.

w2Sub.message: The light moves with the sun, and the colors change with the hours and the seasons, all year long.

w2Color.message: One quiet tint, or the color of the hour.

w2Light.message: Sunlight crossing your page, dawn to dusk.

w2Leaves.message: An afternoon in the shade of a tree.

w2Breeze.message: Petals, seeds, leaves or snow, by season.

w2Cap.message: The colors shift gently with the hours, and grow paler and cooler in winter.

w3Title.message: Made for the way you work.

w3Focus.message: Need quiet time to concentrate, or about to share your screen in a meeting? Focus mode hides your bookmarks and keeps only the time, your background and, if you like, a few sites as icons.

w3Awake.message: Keep the screen on while you read and take notes, or make sure a long task is not interrupted during your coffee break. From 15 minutes to 4 hours, or until you turn it off.

w1Alt.message: A crowded new tab page empties until only the bookmarks bar is left, then the bookmarks bar becomes ReStart.

w3FocusAlt.message: Before and after: the full page, then only the time.

w3AwakeAlt.message: The Keep Awake button, turned on, and its menu of durations.

snowHint.message: Snow, cherry petals, dandelion seeds or autumn leaves drifting in a slow, gusting wind; Season picks them by the date. They fade where they land on your cards, tiles and search bar.
